description:
Plan: ../recursive-denotations-proposal.html. Stack of PRs on main: PR1 reproducers+signal, PR2 fz-tfn.62 narrow, PR3 fz-kdt.48, PR4 fz-kdt.177 kernel, PR5 fz-kdt.177 semantics.

PR2. quoted_callable_name (src/compiler2/jobs/body.rs ~1307) resolves a callable to a FunctionId at quote lowering and throws the id away, rendering "Module.name" into the quoted head atom (~1231). Add an exclusive compiler-minted classification to QuotedSourceMetadata (src/compiler2/source.rs ~161): Bound(FunctionId) or Missing{owner, ref, arity}, encoded outside the visible META_* entries so a macro editing the map cannot forge it; the head atom stays the bare spelling as display data. Delete the render. Test: quoted_call_retains_the_provider_function_id, and port_macros_test.rs:209 upgraded from assert_resolved to asserting the lowered target's FunctionId and the value 107.
title: Retain the resolved callable on quoted metadata; delete the rendered name
